subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding compound interest/growth and why starting to invest early makes a big difference over time
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two simulated savings plans — one starting early, one starting later — and observes the ending totals
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a growth curve to the plan that started earlier versus later
exercise.abstract: Student explains why starting to invest earlier, even with smaller amounts, tends to grow into more money than starting later with larger amounts

misconception_flags: believes only the total amount invested matters, not how much time it has to grow

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
